scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && bunx dts-bundle-generator --project tsconfig.json --no-check --export-referenced-types false -o dist/index.d.ts src/index.ts && bunx dts-bundle-generator --project tsconfig.json --no-check --export-referenced-types false -o dist/actor.d.ts src/actor.ts && bunx dts-bundle-generator --project tsconfig.json --no-check --export-referenced-types false -o dist/widget.d.ts src/widget.ts && bunx dts-bundle-generator --project tsconfig.json --no-check --export-referenced-types false -o dist/bridge.d.ts src/bridge.ts && bun build src/index.ts src/actor.ts src/widget.ts src/bridge.ts --target=browser --format=esm --external @arrow-js/core --outdir=dist
